08116 Shimriyth {shim-reeth'}

源自 08113; 陰性專有名詞 人名 

AV - Shimrith 1; 1

示米利 = "警覺的"
1) 一位摩押婦女, 約薩拔的母親, 約薩拔是刺殺猶大王約阿施的人之一 (#代下 24:26|)
record.edic_text:
08116 Shimriyth {shim-reeth'}

from 08113;; n pr f

AV - Shimrith 1; 1

Shimrith = "vigilant"
1) a Moabitess, mother of Jehozabad, one of the assassins of king
   Joash of Judah
